subject: OPEN statement
notes: kb/Work PB324 (landed). This rule is a pointer -- 'Additional rules affecting the execution of the OPEN statement are given in 12.4.5, File control entry, General rules 3 and 4' (cite.py --check 14.9.27.4 OK, 26) -- and both referred rules now hold. GR3 b) (cite.py --check 12.4.5.3 OK, 3) b)): 'When the USING phrase of the ASSIGN clause is specified, the file connector referenced by file-name-1 is associated with a physical file identified by the content of the data item referenced by data-name-1 in the runtime element that executes the OPEN, SORT, or MERGE statement.' GR3's lead sentence fixes the timing (cite.py --check 12.4.5.3 OK, 3): 'The association occurs at the time of execution of an OPEN, SORT, or MERGE statement that referenced file-name-1.' PREVIOUSLY DIVERGES on both halves: DataBinder.BindFileControl read only assignClause().assignTarget(), so the USING dataReference was read nowhere in src and a bare `ASSIGN USING data-name-1` file kept FileModel.AssignTarget's file-name default -- the records landed in `<file-name>.txt` with no diagnostic -- while CobolFile.ResolveHostPath ran once from FileRegistry.Register at unit activation into a get-only HostPath, so no OPEN ever re-resolved. FIX: the binder captures BOTH phrases on both general-format arms; the emitter renders the EXECUTING element's own specification AT the statement (SequentialIoEmitter.ExecutingElementArgs, passed as an argument of every OPEN and of the SORT/MERGE implicit opens); FileConnector.Associate(spec, dynamic) is the ONE writer of HostPath and FileRegistry.OpenCore -- the single OPEN dispatch that Open, OpenNoRewind, OpenShared and the implicit opens all funnel through (14.9.40.4 GR12a/GR15a, 14.9.24.4 GR7a) -- is its only caller. A bare-USING connector registers UNASSOCIATED (empty host path) and a DELETE FILE before the first OPEN takes 14.9.10.4 GR14's successful '05' (cite.py --check 14.9.10.4 OK, 14) rather than deleting a file the program never named. GR3's closing sentence gets the status the standard reserves for it: 9.1.13.6 item 2's '31' (cite.py --check 9.1.13.6 OK, 2). GR4's implementor obligations (allowable content; consistency rules) are now stated -- docs/CONFORMANCE.md section 7, DOC-A.1-73 and DOC-A.1-10. SIBLING SWEPT: FileRegistry's ConnectorShare cached a host path taken at RegisterSharing time and six physical-file-table lookups read that copy; a mutable association makes it a stale sharing key, so the field is gone and every lookup reads the connector's own HostPath. 12.4.5.2 SR7 is enforced at bind time (COBOL1810 category, COBOL1811 subordinate-to-own-FD). PROBE (before): `SELECT FU ASSIGN USING WS-NAME` with two OPEN OUTPUTs and a MOVE between them wrote both records to fu.txt and created neither target file. PROBE (after): target1.dat holds AAAA, target2.dat holds BBBB, fu.txt does not exist. || EDITIONS AS ADJUDICATED: 1985 / 2002 / 2014 / 2023 for the ASSIGN TO arm of 12.4.5.3 GR3/GR4; their USING-phrase arm from 2002 -- the USING phrase is a COBOL-2002 introduction (kb/Work PB746): Annex E never names it, so it predates 2023, and GnuCOBOL 3.2's per-standard dialect files date it at 2002 (cobol85.conf assign-using-variable: unconformable; cobol2002.conf and cobol2014.conf: ok; cobc -std=cobol85 refuses `ASSIGN USING`) - constructs row assign-using-2002, VCR row 7.27; below 2002 the phrase is COBOL0900 on both arms (conformance:cases/12.4.5-File-control/pb746-assign-using-below-2002). The arm rides conformance:cases/12.4.5-File-control/pb746_assign_using_2002 at its introducing edition. || RE-VERDICTED 2026-09-05 (kb/Work PB673): the ORIGINAL fix installed the source as a closure on the connector, unguarded at every activation, and that was wrong for the same reason the guarded alternative was -- a connector is neither per-element nor per-activation. An EXTERNAL file connector is ONE object per run unit shared by every describing element (13.18.22.4 GR4 a) whose entries 12.4.5.3 GR1 b) requires only to be CONSISTENT, and a RECURSIVE non-INITIAL unit's connector is unit-scoped while its LOCAL-STORAGE is per-activation -- so the installed closure answered with whichever element/activation ran its prologue LAST, at status '00'. GR3 b)'s 'in the runtime element that executes' is now structural: the operands are ARGUMENTS of the OPEN with no defaults, so an emitter path that omits them is a compile error. conformance:cases/12.4.5-File-control/pb673_external_assign_executor pins the cross-PROGRAM face and conformance:cases/12.4.5-File-control/pb673_recursive_assign_linage the cross-ACTIVATION one. GR1 b)'s own implementor obligation (Annex A.1 item 72), which had NO determination while the rule was already being enforced by the SelectFingerprint EC-EXTERNAL-FILE-MISMATCH check, is now docs/CONFORMANCE.md section 7, DOC-A.1-72. retired-witness: conformance:85/pb324_assign_using_85 (moved to conformance:cases/12.4.5-File-control/pb746_assign_using_2002: the USING phrase is a 2002 introduction (kb/Work PB746), so the golden runs at its introducing edition)
